query: SELECT count(*) as "count!" FROM score_card_skips WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR scorer_account_id = $6::varchar) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR target_account_id = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR reason = $10::text) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR created_at = $12::timestamptz)
